# Paul Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** Young child  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083)</sub>

## Appearance

Paul is a sturdy, handsome boy with brown curls and dark blue eyes that match his father's. He has grown big, brown, and healthy since coming to live in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v2 c28 P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)_

## Personality

Paul is an imaginative, thoughtful, and expressive young boy with a gentle, poetic mind. He enjoys creating elaborate mental fancies and sharing his deep thoughts with those he feels understand him. Despite his rich imagination, he is fair-minded, manly, and quite capable of holding his own in physical games and protecting his principles.

_Sources: [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027), [v2 c19 P33](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0033)_

## Traits

- Imaginative  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028), [v2 c19 P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)</sub>
- Manly
- Fair-minded
- Patriotic

## Abilities

- Storytelling and creating imaginative characters  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)</sub>
- Holding his own in games and fighting for his beliefs

## Goals

- To share his imaginative thoughts with someone who understands him  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c19 P27](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0027)</sub>

## History

Paul moved from Boston to Avonlea to live with his grandmother on the shore road. At school, he became a devoted student of Anne Shirley, bonding deeply with her over shared imaginative thoughts, poetic fancies, and rock people creations. During his time in Avonlea, he engaged in a drawn physical fight with St. Clair Donnell after defending the Stars and Stripes flag, earning mutual respect for his patriotism. He also regularly writes letters and compositions to his teacher detailing his imaginary rock people like Nora, the Golden Lady, and the Twin Sailors. When his father, Stephen Irving, made an unexpected visit to Avonlea, Paul excitedly welcomed him and introduced him to Anne. Through Anne's connection with Miss Lavendar Lewis, Paul indirectly helps reconnect his father with his former romance.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041), [v2 c11 P42](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0042), [v2 c11 P43](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0043), [v2 c19 P26](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0026), [v2 c28 P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 c28 P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023), [v2 c28 P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)_

- Born in Boston to Stephen Irving and his late mother  <sub>[v2 c21 P83](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0083), [v2 c19 P25](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0025)</sub>

## Quotes

> I think the most interesting people I know are my rock people and I mean to tell you about them.  <sub>[v2 c11 P41](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0041)</sub>

> I think the evening star is a lighthouse on the land where the fairies dwell.  <sub>[v2 c19 P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)</sub>

> Do you know what I think about the new moon, teacher? I think it is a little golden boat full of dreams.  <sub>[v2 c19 P30](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0030)</sub>

> Oh, Miss Shirley, you can’t think what has happened! Something so splendid. Father is here . . . just think of that! Father is here!  <sub>[v2 c28 P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021)</sub>
